resolution: Scoped the / dashboard stats to the selected map. Removed the deferred global asset/texture/material store censuses from DashboardRoute because those library-wide numbers stayed constant while switching maps and read as current-map facts. The route now derives every visible metric from map props: chunks, placed count, unique kinds, painted area, world extent, coverage, open ground, and most-placed labels. Verified hmsc-int bundle plus mapReport and placementStats suites.
